reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies between transparency and trust—wherein the system enforces a dual regime: one where signals are fully traceable (factor trail), and another where performance is only revealed once sufficient empirical grounding exists (gated performance). This creates a mathematical constraint on information disclosure, modeled as a conditional probability P(S|F) and P(W|H). The failure mode occurs when either F is incomplete or H insufficiently large, leading to invalidation of S or W respectively. The system avoids synthetic data by enforcing that every S must originate from an actual market line, ensuring that the factor trail T is always anchored in real-time odds data. The calibration process thus becomes a recursive Bayesian update over T, where prior beliefs are refined with new evidence from D, M, C, and F. The gating mechanism ensures that W is not prematurely exposed, maintaining the integrity of the probabilistic model until convergence criteria are met.
